task_summary: Migrated ProposalSlideCanvas to theme-invariant institutional slide tokens and shared edit-state Badges; removed the broad dark-mode descendant override and fixed mobile edit-cue/title overlap. ProposalSlideCanvas tests pass 5/5, scoped ESLint has zero errors with two existing warnings, scoped Prettier passes, and the client build passes with 4,853 modules. Eight SSR Playwright captures plus two mobile scroll-end captures cover light/dark at 1440x900 and 390x844. Inventory: 138 source-updated, 3 reviewed-no-ui, 137 pending; the complete refactor remains active.
key_decisions: Centralized official proposal-slide navy, gold, orange, ink, slate, and green colors as theme-invariant tokens so utilities retain original BukSU colors in both app themes.
Used the shared Badge for edit indicators and placed the content-slide badge in header flow to prevent title overlap on narrow screens.
Removed the broad dark-mode descendant override because it recolored cover subtitle and edit cue descendants; content and footer use explicit component tokens.
Used offline Vite SSR plus production stylesheet for visual review after isolated Playwright could not reach local previews. Route-integrated browser visual evidence remains open for final coverage.
lessons_learned: Dark-mode checks must inspect descendant text on institutional canvases; broad selectors can break white/gold text on navy covers.
An absolutely positioned status pill can overlap headings when a 16:9 slide scales to mobile; normal header flow preserves both access and geometry.
open_threads: Full refactor remains active: 138/278 source modules are source-updated, 3 reviewed-no-ui, and 137 pending.
The isolated Playwright process cannot reach the app or local Vite preview; rerun route-integrated visual audits when the workspace preview is reachable.
Continue P7 with ProposalTab.jsx, then remaining proposals, project/course workspaces; complete P8-P11 and all final governance/testing gates.
